greeting.say: Namaste! Main WorryQ se bol raha hun. Kya aap kaam dhundh rahe hain?

ask_location.say: Bahut accha! Aap Ahmedabad mein kahan rehte hain? GIDC area mein?

ask_skills.say: Aap kaunsa kaam karte hain? Jaise welding, fabrication, machining, ya kuch aur?

ask_experience.say: Kitne saal ka anubhav hai aapko is kaam mein?

ask_availability.say: Aap kab se kaam shuru kar sakte hain? Abhi immediately ya kuch din baad?

ask_salary.say: Aapki expected salary kitni hai per month?

closing_success.say: Bahut accha! Maine aapka details note kar liya. Humara HR team aapko 2-3 din mein call karega. Dhanyawaad aur alvida!

closing_not_interested.say: Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Agar kabhi zaroorat ho to hume call karein. Dhanyawaad aur alvida!

closing_callback.say: Theek hai, hum baad mein call karenge. Dhanyawaad aur alvida!
